summary: The team has habits nobody writes down, like when people arrive, leave or gather for breakfast.
realLife: Career guidance for new hires says team routines often go unstated, and that watching colleagues and asking them directly avoids awkward surprises. Examples are arrival and departure times and group meals.
sources: Atlassian Work Life, starting a new job and first week success: https://www.atlassian.com/blog/teamwork/starting-a-new-job-and-first-week-success
inGame: Needs: a per-workplace habits record; today it can ride on the job record (employer, position, workplace, pay, tenure) in the jobs module and coworker ties, and be told by a senior coworker when the new-coworker event fires. Scene: needs a producer for first-day-ropes.

turns.summary: A senior coworker walks the newcomer through the habits on the first day.
turns.writesBack: A tie with the senior coworker gets closer, and the newcomer fits in sooner.

turns.summary: The newcomer breaks a habit, such as arriving late to the morning gathering, and is teased.
pulledBy: a newcomer who is shy and does not ask
turns.writesBack: The newcomer's mood dips and a coworker tie stays distant.

turns.summary: The manager hands over a short written page of how the team works.
turns.writesBack: The newcomer starts steady, and the manager tie gets a bit warmer.
